purpose: Structured projection of Brew's current architecture reconciliation and acceptance gates. Navigation state only; live repository/runtime evidence remains authoritative.
authority_rule: Current Brew main source, exact local workspace revision, runtime evidence, CI, and project-owned checkpoints outrank this projection.

nodes.title: One reasoning agent and deterministic runtime boundaries
nodes.summary: Current project contract keeps semantic reasoning with the model while runtime owns execution, policy, identity, state, evidence, and recovery.

nodes.title: Canonical /query -> runTurn path
nodes.summary: Current main statically confirms /query invokes runTurn with explicit workspaceRoot/stateRoot and the runner identifies the canonical loop as single-agent.

nodes.title: Classify auxiliary semantic and legacy surfaces
nodes.summary: Trace dispatch-handlers, agent-dispatch, workspace-agent, active-read/provider planners, main-agent connector, and execution-router by actual caller/reachability and semantic authority.

nodes.title: Execution-router semantic boundary
nodes.summary: routeExecution uses optimization mode, keyword matching, and message length. Prove whether tier selection only optimizes an established action or changes semantic planning/execution authority.

nodes.title: Remove fail-closed legacy subagent/team debt after caller proof
nodes.summary: subagent-engine and team-coordinator should remain fail-closed until legacy handlers and supported consumers are removed.

nodes.title: Reconcile PR #442 with current main
nodes.summary: PR #442 remains draft/diverged: 78 commits ahead and 4 behind current main. Classify unique, superseded, and still-required work before merge/closure.

nodes.title: Dynamic local-tool revision identity
nodes.summary: Hot reload is on main; exact loaded tool/manifest revision should be attributable in execution evidence before stronger dynamic-tool claims.

nodes.title: Installed cold-start and restart proof
nodes.summary: Prove canonical state root, readiness, runtime truth, clean shutdown, restart, and state rediscovery on the actual installed runtime.

nodes.title: Cancellation/restart/exactly-once recovery
nodes.summary: Consequential retries and crash/resume behavior need operation-bound live evidence.

nodes.title: Current-head CI and release acceptance
nodes.summary: Do not infer CI, installed runtime, or release readiness from source/focused tests.
